name: Goat Format

reference_parity.reason: Goat Format is DEFINED here as a reproduction of Project Ignis's battle-tested GOAT implementation: this format's pool and banlist were themselves decomposed from GOAT.lflist.conf, and the generated list is regression-tested to stay entry-for-entry identical to it. The reference list substitutes the upstream historical version of every card that has one, so this format does too - including cards whose difference research found to be period text rather than behaviour, and cards whose era chronology could not be dated. Every such disagreement between the reference and our own researched chronology is reported per card by the validator rather than hidden inside a hand-maintained include list. Membership is provenance-based: a record counts as part of the reference only if it cites ignis-lflists, because upstream also ships historical variants for cards its own GOAT list does NOT use (Mind Crush, Ultimate Offering) - substituting those would break the parity this policy exists to preserve.

notes: The community-defined retrospective format played under the April 2005 TCG Forbidden/Limited list. period.start is that list's effective date; period.end and the precise pool cutoff still need sourced research (the pool itself is imported extensionally from Project Ignis). snapshot=start is a modeling choice, revisit when release data lands. errata_overrides.reference_parity replaced the old 211-entry errata_overrides.include list: Goat Format is defined here as a reproduction of Project Ignis's GOAT.lflist.conf, so this format substitutes whatever the reference substitutes (provenance-based, via provenance_source: ignis-lflists) rather than hand-listing 211 card ids. The generated list stays entry-for-entry identical to the reference; every disagreement between the reference and this project's own researched chronology is reported per card (format.parity-substitutes-non-behavioural / -contradicts-chronology / -omits-historical) instead of hidden inside the list. See docs/errata.md and formats/2005-04-goat/notes.md.
